THE IDEA

A pin should tell you more.

The goal is to separate place type, evidence review, and recent community observations so every pin has context.

01 / FIND
⌕

Start with the area

Search a landmark or browse the Metro Manila map. Location access is optional.

02 / CHECK
✓

Read the status

See whether designation was evidence reviewed, community reported, or disputed.

03 / CONTRIBUTE
↗

Keep it current

Confirm a place, suggest a correction, or report an issue for review.
